## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this feature solve? Who benefits (students, partners,
teachers, admins)? Describe the use case rather than a specific solution.

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. If it touches the
architecture, note where it would live (controller / service / Inertia page /
component).

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Scope & Impact

- Affected interface(s): [ ] Admin [ ] Student [ ] Partner [ ] Public
- Does it require database/schema changes? (migrations, seeders)
- Does it affect existing flows (cases, applications, gamification, simulator)?

## Additional Context

Add mockups, references, or any other context here.
